{{Quote|A ruined city, like amber trapped in the Sonoro. Once-bustling streets lie overgrown with wild grass, low roads swallowed by seawater. The Lament repeats endlessly, and time and space are fractured, but this view seems frozen, stopped in a silent eternity.|[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main#regions Wuthering Waves Official Website]}}
